title: Bolden's family again
summary: Asked more about Bolden's family, she knew his mother and sister, who lived near her mother-in-law on Second Street.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You mentioned you knew the family of Mr. Bowman. I wonder if you could tell us anything more about that. Oh, Lord. I knew Drew's mother and his sister and things, but I don't know anything anymore. I never visited him, you know, that much. And that was right after Buddy lost his mind and they put him in. I used to talk to his sister. Yeah. After Buddy was gone. Yeah, after all that, after he was gone or something like that. Because they knew my mother-in-law well. Mother lived in the same neighborhood once before I was married. Where were they living then? Right there on 2nd Street. Right, 2nd Street. In Franklin and Liberty.
